cards.title: What the DSP is actually doing
items: Each stream is convolved with a head-related transfer function, so a source behind you is shaped by pinna reflections rather than just panned
Interaural time and level differences carry the rest of the position, which is why the output is two channels and not a downmix
This runs on the Tensor G6 audio DSP rather than the CPU, so it does not compete with your app for frame budget

cards.title: Why head tracking needs its own feed
items: The earbud IMU streams pitch, yaw and roll at 100 Hz over LE Audio or AAC, independently of the audio stream itself
The Spatializer rotates the virtual speaker array opposite to your head, which is what keeps the speakers fixed in the room
Without a tracking-capable headset the pipeline still spatialises, it just stops compensating for head movement
